text: Hi {name}! Sending you some {what} to help with your next project. Have a wonderful day and happy crafting!
Good morning, sunshine! Here is a little care package of goodies for you. Let me know if you need anything else.
Hey there, friend! Thought you could put these to good use, so I am mailing {what} your way. Big hugs!
Yay, it is your lucky day! Enjoy these materials and tell me how they turn out, I am excited to hear.
Warm wishes from your favorite adventurer! Here is a bundle to keep you busy for a while. Cheers!
Listen here, {name}, I got {what} for ye. Don't go wastin' it on frivolous nonsense, ye hear?
Bah, took me three hours to gather this lot. Ye'd better appreciate it, lad, and don't be late returnin' the favor.
Mail's here and so is the stuff. Stop complainin' that it's late, it's not my fault the road's full of goblins.
Ach, here's yer {what}. Don't come whinin' to me when it runs out faster than ye expected. Hmph.
Ye asked for it, so here it be. Now get off yer backside and make somethin' worthwhile with it, {name}.
Good evening, {name}. I have taken the liberty of dispatching {what} at your earliest convenience. Most respectfully yours.
It is my distinct pleasure to forward the enclosed items. Kindly confirm receipt at your leisure, sir or madam.
Pardon the delay in correspondence. The requested goods are now dispatched, and I trust they meet your exacting standards.
Might I say, your order has been packed with the utmost care and awaits collection. Do enjoy it immensely.
I humbly submit this parcel for your perusal. Should anything be amiss, do not hesitate to write back at once.
Ahoy {name}! Me crew sent ye a crate of {what} from the back of the cargo hold. Savvy?
Arr, the sea was rough but the loot be safe. Here's a share of the plunder for ye, matey.
Yo ho! I have cached some treasures in this here envelope. Use them well or walk the plank, no hard feelings.
Shiver me timbers, {name}, I dug up {what} from the sand. Ye owe me a rum for this, ye scallywag.
Avast, a fine haul for ye today. Do no' spend it all on grog, or I'll be hearin' about it from the parrot.
